scope: Control: integer keys of two unrelated sources may coincide numerically. Equality of keys across sources must not be accepted without a reviewed shared identifier space.

integer.meaning: Numeric identifiers; outer whitespace and a zero-only decimal suffix such as .0 are formatting. Leading zeroes are numeric padding only for these ID columns.

normalizationContract.scope: Applies to the declared cross key columns only; equal numbers do not imply the same entity.

relations.reason: Control: NYC TLC LocationID and SEC SIC code are both small integers but name different things; declared without a shared space and without review
